displayName: AI Endpoint With Model Garden Deployment

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Hugging Face Model ID
fields.help: The Hugging Face model to deploy.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Resource ID segment making up resource 'location'.

fields.label: Publisher Model Name
fields.help: The Model Garden model to deploy.

fields.label: Deploy Config
Fast Tryout Enabled
fields.help: If true, enable the QMT fast tryout feature for this model if possible.

fields.label: Dedicated Resources
Max Replica Count
fields.help: The maximum number of replicas that may be deployed on when the traffic against it increases.

fields.label: Min Replica Count
fields.help: The minimum number of machine replicas that will be always deployed on.

fields.label: Required Replica Count
fields.help: Number of required available replicas for the deployment to succeed.

fields.label: Spot
fields.help: If true, schedule the deployment workload on [spot VMs](https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/concepts/spot-vms).

fields.label: Autoscaling Metric Specs
Metric Name
fields.help: The resource metric name.

fields.label: Target
fields.help: The target resource utilization in percentage (1% - 100%) for the given metric; once the real usage deviates from the target by a certain percentage, the machine replicas change.
The metric specifications that overrides a resource utilization metric (CPU utilization, accelerator's duty cycle, and so on) target value (default to 60 if not set).

fields.label: Machine Spec
Accelerator Count
fields.help: The number of accelerators to attach to the machine.

fields.label: Accelerator Type
fields.help: Possible values: ACCELERATOR_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED NVIDIA_TESLA_K80 NVIDIA_TESLA_P100 NVIDIA_TESLA_V100 NVIDIA_TESLA_P4 NVIDIA_TESLA_T4 NVIDIA_TESLA_A100 NVIDIA_A100_80GB NVIDIA_L4 NVIDIA_H100_80GB NVID...

fields.label: Machine Type
fields.help: The type of the machine.

fields.label: Multihost Gpu Node Count
fields.help: The number of nodes per replica for multihost GPU deployments.

fields.label: Tpu Topology
fields.help: The topology of the TPUs.

fields.label: Reservation Affinity
Key
fields.help: Corresponds to the label key of a reservation resource.

fields.label: Reservation Affinity Type
fields.help: Specifies the reservation affinity type.

fields.label: Values
fields.help: Corresponds to the label values of a reservation resource.
A ReservationAffinity can be used to configure a Vertex AI resource (e.g., a DeployedModel) to draw its Compute Engine resources from a Shared Reservation, or exclusively from on-demand capacity.
Specification of a single machine.
A description of resources that are dedicated to a DeployedModel or DeployedIndex, and that need a higher degree of manual configuration.
The deploy config to use for the deployment.

fields.label: Endpoint Config
Dedicated Endpoint Enabled
fields.help: If true, the endpoint will be exposed through a dedicated DNS [Endpoint.dedicated_endpoint_dns].

fields.label: Endpoint Display Name
fields.help: The user-specified display name of the endpoint.

fields.label: Private Service Connect Config
Enable Private Service Connect
fields.help: Required.

fields.label: Project Allowlist
fields.help: A list of Projects from which the forwarding rule will target the service attachment.

fields.label: Psc Automation Configs
Network
fields.help: Required.

fields.label: Project ID
fields.help: Required.
PSC config that is used to automatically create PSC endpoints in the user projects.
The configuration for Private Service Connect (PSC).
The endpoint config to use for the deployment.

fields.label: Model Config
Accept Eula
fields.help: Whether the user accepts the End User License Agreement (EULA) for the model.

fields.label: Hugging Face Access Token
fields.help: The Hugging Face read access token used to access the model artifacts of gated models.

fields.label: Hugging Face Cache Enabled
fields.help: If true, the model will deploy with a cached version instead of directly downloading the model artifacts from Hugging Face.

fields.label: Model Display Name
fields.help: The user-specified display name of the uploaded model.

fields.label: Container Spec
Args
fields.help: Specifies arguments for the command that runs when the container starts.

fields.label: Command
fields.help: Specifies the command that runs when the container starts.

fields.label: Deployment Timeout
fields.help: Deployment timeout.

fields.label: Health Route
fields.help: HTTP path on the container to send health checks to.

fields.label: Image Uri
fields.help: URI of the Docker image to be used as the custom container for serving predictions.

fields.label: Predict Route
fields.help: HTTP path on the container to send prediction requests to.

fields.label: Shared Memory Size Mb
fields.help: The amount of the VM memory to reserve as the shared memory for the model in megabytes.

fields.label: Env
Name
fields.help: Name of the environment variable.

fields.label: Value
fields.help: Variables that reference a $(VAR_NAME) are expanded using the previous defined environment variables in the container and any service environment variables.
List of environment variables to set in the container.

fields.label: Grpc Ports
Container Port
fields.help: The number of the port to expose on the pod's IP address.
List of ports to expose from the container.

fields.label: Health Probe
Failure Threshold
fields.help: Number of consecutive failures before the probe is considered failed.

fields.label: Initial Delay Seconds
fields.help: Number of seconds to wait before starting the probe.

fields.label: Period Seconds
fields.help: How often (in seconds) to perform the probe.

fields.label: Success Threshold
fields.help: Number of consecutive successes before the probe is considered successful.

fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.help: Number of seconds after which the probe times out.

fields.label: Exec
Command
fields.help: Command is the command line to execute inside the container, the working directory for the command is root ('/') in the container's filesystem.
ExecAction specifies a command to execute.

fields.label: Grpc
Port
fields.help: Port number of the gRPC service.

fields.label: Service
fields.help: Service is the name of the service to place in the gRPC HealthCheckRequest.
GrpcAction checks the health of a container using a gRPC service.

fields.label: Http Get
Host
fields.help: Host name to connect to, defaults to the model serving container's IP.

fields.label: Path
fields.help: Path to access on the HTTP server.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: Number of the port to access on the container.

fields.label: Scheme
fields.help: Scheme to use for connecting to the host.

fields.label: Http Headers
Name
fields.help: The header field name.

fields.label: Value
fields.help: The header field value
Custom headers to set in the request.
HttpGetAction describes an action based on HTTP Get requests.

fields.label: Tcp Socket
Host
fields.help: Optional: Host name to connect to, defaults to the model serving container's IP.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: Number of the port to access on the container.
TcpSocketAction probes the health of a container by opening a TCP socket connection.
Probe describes a health check to be performed against a container to determine whether it is alive or ready to receive traffic.
